root_cause: The R2B wrap entry used a distance offset from the flower-nearest backbone point, which placed the orange wrap channel on the middle of a backbone slope instead of near the other detected wave trough.
proposed_change: Derive the wrap entry from the Stage-2 detected trough that is distinct from the support entry, then route the wrap channel from that trough through the lower outer flower perimeter. Preserve the frozen topology, region-only generation order, and all existing thresholds.
